workflow: An operation caches the size of a mutable container before invoking user-controlled output callbacks.
A callback re-enters the container and clears or replaces its backing storage.
The outer operation continues iterating using the cached size without revalidating the container state.
It dereferences the invalidated backing pointer, causing a null-pointer or use-after-free crash.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates active container storage
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches reentrant mutation of the same container invalidating storage while the original operation continues using stale state.
